findings.defect: waitForFile returns on the first inotify event where existsSync(target) is true; the recorder's Bun.write is openat(O_CREAT) then a separate write(), so the loop can return while argv.json is empty and JSON.parse('') throws. CI runs this E2E with LEGION_E2E=1 (pr-and-main.yaml:97), so it is a red-CI path for every PR.
findings.evidence: Reproduced with a throwaway harness running the real fixture under an identical watch()+existsSync loop, 300 iterations on this box at load average ~100: ok 283, empty 17 (5.7%), parseErr 0. Deep-review's strace confirmed the two-syscall sequence.
findings.mustChange: Either make the recorder atomic (write argv.json.tmp then renameSync to argv.json — recommended) or have waitForFile treat the target as ready only when non-empty (statSync(target).size > 0).
